title: Vector Masking in Hana
summary: Explore the latest features, fixes, and improvements in 3D design with Spline.
body_markdown: Masks let you hide or reveal content using a vector shape. Instead of permanently erasing parts of an image or layer, a mask defines which areas remain visible. Everything inside the mask shape is shown, while anything outside is hidden. Vector Masks can also be animated and interactive using events and actions.
